description: Presenter footage alternates with numbered explanatory motion cards, colored bars and icon groups.

techniques.name: Numbered explanatory card cutaways
techniques.evidence: A large chapter number is replaced by color bars and an aligned icon group before returning to presenter footage.
implementation: Alternate original footage with concise motion cards.
Animate related elements as a group with small stagger.
Keep the chapter number and headline hierarchy clear.

typography: Compact bold headlines, large chapter numerals and short presenter captions.
composition: Result is embedded in a raised rounded card against a blue background; no editor controls are visible.
effects: Number transitions, grouped bar entrances and icon staging.
easing: Exact source interpolation is uncertain. Any stored guidance is an original cubic-ease design recommendation, not a recovered curve.
uncertainties: The presenter speech was not transcribed, so educational advice and exact narration timing are uncertain.
reviewer: Codex visual review of sampled source frames
